label: Industrial employment share
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = Eurostat nama_10_a10_e pinned na_item=EMP_DC (total employment domestic concept — the door also prints SAL_DC employees and SELF_DC self-employed, unwired), unit=PC_TOT_PER (percentage of total — the door's OWN share unit; the counts face THS_PER and the index face I15_* refused), nace_r2=B-E ("Industry (except construction)" — the door's own aggregate label, verified live 2026-09-21): 34 countries + aggregates dropped (EU27_2020/EA/EA21/ EA20/EA19/EA12 — EA the bare two-letter Euro-area aggregate, dropped logged as _DATASET_TWO_LETTER_AGGREGATES records), no sex dimension (both-sexes by construction), FR/DE 1995-2024 full annual series (FR 16.4 -> 10.1, DE 23.1 -> 17.5), the EA aggregates' own prints riding the drop log. Witness tier = the ILO modeled shares, world 1991-2024, industry INCLUDING construction. The root pair eurostat_na/ilo_modelled: same underlying national accounts and surveys, one modeling step and one construction-coverage apart.

notes: THE COMPOSITE-DERIVED-LAYER QUESTION, RETIRED (the v18 probe record in sources.yaml): the v15 finding "NO collector wire prints the % as-reported (ILO/OECD = counts; WB = ILOEST modeled)" was true of every door probed THEN — ILOSTAT's registry (re-verified v18: the _RT flows are informal-employment and employment-to-population rates, no plain sector-share flow), the OECD doors (harmonized), the DYB (the economic-characteristic tables were dropped before the live XLS archive begins — the wired editions 2011-2024 carry none, the 1970s-90s tables Todd read are print-era, and the unstats archive's 2001-2006 XLS era has no industry table either, probed). The national-accounts door was the un-probed gap: PC_TOT_PER prints the share the countries themselves publish. No ADR needed — the reserve decision retires unused. THE DEFINITIONAL NOTE (the honest face): Todd's own "industry" is broader than the canonical's B-E — Le Destin des immigrés counts mines+manufacturing+construction+transport for its 1841 Britain board, and the OECD-era Labour Force Statistics "Industry" the L'illusion board reads included construction. The canonical prints the door's own aggregate (B-E, except construction); the construction share rides the SAME door one nace code away (nama_10_a10_e/EMP_DC/PC_TOT_PER/F, unwired, recorded in sources.yaml); the witness prints the incl-construction definition — the seam is displayed, the definitional choice is documented, and a B-E+F SUM would be a derivation the constitution forbids (the very derivation the composite ADR would have legitimized — no longer needed because the door prints its own aggregate honestly). THE HISTORICAL FACE: L'invention de l'Europe's c.1880 and c.1970 maps are BOOK tables (census-era), territory curated, not a living wire — the same class as unemployment's interwar Austria and cirrhosis's 19th-century France. The lfsa_egan2 LFS counts door, the SAL_DC/SELF_DC items and the remaining nace aggregates are recorded unwired in sources.yaml.
